blocking_concerns.text: The export has two key labels. The naming claim defines credential X as acme-prod only, but the derived total of 1,160 includes the 60 acme-prod-2 requests; recomputing over acme-prod gives 1,100. The billing claim states as fact that billing uses only credential X, yet the 2026-09-15 row shows billing on acme-prod-2.
The packet never says whether credential X has already been rotated. That decides whether the rotation it plans is still needed.
docs/vendor-key-policy.txt does not match its manifest digest, so neither claim citing it can be checked.

suggestions.text: The legacy-batch inference could mention that legacy-batch and reports both appear in the same week, which weakens the rename reading without contradicting it.
